the act of the 10th of april, 1816, ch..english:
The Act of the 10th of April, 1816, ch. 44, to "incorporate the subscribers to the Bank of the United States" is a law made in pursuance of the Constitution.
The Government of the Union, though limited in its powers, is supreme within its sphere of action, and its laws, when made in pursuance of the Constitution, form the supreme law of the land.
There is nothing in the Constitution of the United States similar to the Articles of Confederation, which exclude incidental or implied powers.
If the end be legitimate, and within the scope of the Constitution, all the means which are appropriate, which are plainly adapted to that end, and which are not prohibited, may constitutionally be employed to carry it into effect.
The power of establishing a corporation is not a distinct sovereign power or end of Government, but only the means of carrying into effect other powers which are sovereign. Whenever it becomes an appropriate means of exercising any of the powers given by the Constitution to the Government of the Union, it may be exercised by that Government.
the act of the 10th of april, 1816, ch..our_language:
Act ya 10th of April,1816, ch. 44, ya " kuincoperate subscribers wa Bank of the United States" ni law ilimakiwa kwa kufuata  katiba
Government ya Muungano, hata kama iko na limitations kwa powers zake, bado iko supreme kwenye sphere yake ya action. Na hizo laws zake, zikiwa made kuenda na Katiba, ndio zinakuwa supreme law ya hii nchi.
Constitution/Katiba ya US haiko kama zile Articles ya Confederation, zenye zilikuwa zina-exclude hizi incidental au implied powers. 
Kama end goal ni legitimate na iko ndani ya scope ya Katiba,  means zote zenye ziko appropriate, zenye zina-adapt vizuri kwa hiyo end, na zenye hazijakuwa prohibited, zinaweza kuwa employed constitutionally/kikatiba kuifanya iwe effective. Kuanzisha corporation si distinct sovereign power au end goal ya Government—ni means tu ya ku-carry into effect zile powers zingine zenye ni sovereign. Wakati wowote ikikuwa appropriate means ya ku-exercise power yoyote yenye Katiba imepea Government ya Muungano, basi hiyo Government inaweza kuitumia.
